axis: slowing something down → stopping it outright

members.tone: The broadest of the three, covering hindering, obstructing and impeding alike, and it frames the act as a course disrupted from outside rather than a way simply blocked.
Flat and absolute: where *interference* only slows or hampers, this names prevention accomplished, with no hint of how it was done.
Puts something in the way, so the check is felt as a mass to be got around rather than *bar*'s clean stop.
